entries.c4336186f34ff6a8: In the cement business, the company manufactures and sells various cements, cement-based solidification materials and ready-mixed concrete, and also sells power at its cement plants and accepts recycled raw and fuel materials for processing. In the mineral products business, the company mines and sells limestone and aggregates; in the building materials business, it manufactures and sells repair materials for concrete structures and performs ground improvement work; in the optoelectronics business, it manufactures and sells optical communication components and measuring instruments; and in the new materials business, it manufactures and sells ceramic products and nanoparticle materials.

entries.d318f21e79493898: The corporate philosophy states, “We aim to be a corporate group that contributes to the maintenance and development of a prosperous society through consideration for the global environment, continuous technological development and diverse business activities,” and the company has set “SOC Vision2035” as its vision for 2035, with environmental solutions as its keyword, aiming to become a company with a presence that society needs through sustainable growth. As the second step, the company has formulated the 2026–28 Medium-Term Management Plan, with the transformation of its business portfolio as the main theme, and says it will work on stabilizing earnings in existing businesses centered on cement, expanding high-value-added products, and launching new businesses.

entries.f222f41466ec4f1d: This reportable segment centers on the manufacture and sale of various cements and cement-based solidifying materials. The company, Hachinohe Cement Co., Ltd. and Wakayama Blast Furnace Cement Co., Ltd. manufacture cement and sell it through exclusive distributors and other channels; the company also manufactures and sells ready-mixed concrete, sells electricity from its cement plants, accepts and processes recycled raw materials and fuels, and provides electrical construction, building repair works and various quality testing services. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer revenue was ¥158,799 million, the largest of the six reportable segments.
